reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so a sachet I just grab in the evening actually fits my life. At $24.99 launch price and with the money-back guarantee I'd try one box, but I wouldn't pay $29.99 yet.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and those last longer. I only get a bargain if I catch the launch price, and I'd want to see if it really beats what I already buy per day.
would_change_my_mind: A regular price near $24.99 or a coupon or flash sale on the two-box deal, so it's clearly under what Toplux costs per day.
